label: development_platform
definition: BRI is presented as infrastructure connectivity trade growth or practical development.
decision_rule: Use when the main emphasis is material cooperation or economic development.

label: strategic_contestation
definition: BRI is presented through competition influence rivalry security or world-order concerns.
decision_rule: Use when geopolitical competition or strategic positioning dominates.

label: managed_opportunity
definition: BRI is presented as beneficial only under rules standards safeguards or institutional management.
decision_rule: Use when opportunity is conditional on governance procedures transparency or dispute management.

label: risk_or_debt
definition: BRI is presented through risk debt dependency financial vulnerability or project failure.
decision_rule: Use when risk language is central rather than incidental.

label: china_state
definition: The actor is named as China Chinese authorities the Chinese government or similar state-level wording.
decision_rule: Use for broad state actor references.

label: beijing_government
definition: The actor is named as Beijing.
decision_rule: Use when the wording implies a central-government or geopolitical actor rather than society as a whole.

label: expert_or_analyst
definition: Evaluation is attributed to an expert analyst scholar or think-tank source.
decision_rule: Use when the quoted or paraphrased source is a named or institutional expert.

label: institution_or_document
definition: Evaluation is attributed to reports policy documents banks courts agencies or official records.
decision_rule: Use when authority comes from an institution or document rather than the journalist.

label: hedged_claim
definition: The text uses may might could likely appear suggest or similar uncertainty markers.
decision_rule: Use when certainty is explicitly softened.

label: strong_claim
definition: The text presents evaluation as high certainty or necessity.
decision_rule: Use when modal strength is clear through must will cannot inevitable or equivalent wording.

label: positive_value
definition: The text evaluates BRI or related actors positively.
decision_rule: Use only when the evaluation is explicit or strongly implied.

label: negative_value
definition: The text evaluates BRI or related actors negatively.
decision_rule: Use only when the evaluation is explicit or strongly implied.

label: conditional_value
definition: The text balances benefit and risk or makes value dependent on conditions.
decision_rule: Use for cautious yes-but or opportunity-under-rules patterns.
